# morphicons

> Morph any SVG icon into any other with spring physics: Lucide, Tabler, Heroicons, Material Symbols, Phosphor or custom paths, stroked or filled. Rotations come out of closed-form 2D Procrustes alignment, never declared by hand. Zero runtime dependencies, ESM, TypeScript. npm package: `morphicons`.

Use it for tasks like "animate the menu icon into an X", "morph between Lucide icons in React" or "transition one SVG icon into another". Change a prop and the icon morphs: no wrappers, keys or per-pair configuration.

```tsx
import { MorphIcon } from "morphicons/react";
import { Menu, X } from "lucide"; // icon data from `lucide`, not `lucide-react` components

<button onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)} aria-expanded={open}>
  <MorphIcon icon={open ? X : Menu} />
</button>
```

Entries: `morphicons/react`, `morphicons/vue`, `morphicons/svelte` (Svelte 5), `morphicons/react-native` (over react-native-svg), `morphicons/astro`, `morphicons/element` (`<morph-icon>` custom element), `morphicons/dom` (`createMorph`, vanilla), `morphicons/adapters` (`svgToIcon`, `maskTarget`, `canvasTarget`), `morphicons` (pure core), `morphicons/region` (fill normalizer, loaded on demand). Framework peers are optional.

- Every binding has three modes: uncontrolled (`icon`), controlled (`from` / `to` / `progress`) and imperative (`morphTo` / `set`).
- Props: `size`, `color`, `strokeWidth`, `absoluteStrokeWidth`, `label`, `spring` (`"snappy"` default, `"smooth"`, `"bouncy"` or `{ stiffness, damping }`), `reducedMotion` (`"never"` default, `"user"`, `"always"`). Exact SSR, `aria-hidden` unless `label` is set.
- Icons are `IconNode` data (Lucide's format) or `d` strings on a 24×24 grid. An icon is filled when one of its elements has a painted `fill`; a `d` string is always stroked. `fitIcon(icon, viewBox)` re-grids a stroked icon from another grid and returns a `d`; `svgToIcon(markup)` reads SVG markup (an Iconify body, a full `<svg>`), fits its `viewBox` to 24 and keeps fills.
- The vanilla driver: `createMorph(pathEl, icon, { reducedMotion, strokeWidth })` returns `morphTo(icon, spring?)`, `set(icon)`, `seek(icon, t)`, `progress`, `reducedMotion`, `strokeWidth` and `destroy()`. A `morphTo` mid-flight keeps the spring's velocity; all instances share one `requestAnimationFrame`.
- Filled icons morph through a ~5.4 KB gzip chunk fetched on first use. `setRegionLoader(async () => region)` with `import * as region from "morphicons/region"` bundles it; `preloadRegion()` prefetches it. Both come from `morphicons/dom`. `toRegion(icon)` from `morphicons/region` precomputes a filled shape at build time.
- `maskTarget` and `canvasTarget` draw strokes only.

## Docs

- [Docs](https://www.morphicons.com/docs): install, the three modes, every binding, filled icons, adapters, icon libraries and how it works
- [Full documentation as markdown](https://www.morphicons.com/llms-full.txt): the README plus how the math works
- [README on GitHub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guillermolg00/morphicons/main/README.md)

## Code

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/guillermolg00/morphicons)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/morphicons)

## Optional

- [Playground](https://www.morphicons.com/): live morphs between ten icon libraries (Lucide, Heroicons, Tabler, Phosphor, Material Symbols, Iconoir, Remix Icon, Material Design Icons, Bootstrap Icons, MingCute), outline and fill, with spring, speed, stroke and a progress scrubber
- [Showcase](https://www.morphicons.com/showcase): copy-paste components, plus mask and canvas adapter demos
- [Roadmap](https://www.morphicons.com/roadmap)
